name: auto-validation-shellcheck-provider

files.fake-shellcheck:
set -eu
if [ "$#" -ne 3 ] || [ "$1" != "-f" ] || [ "$2" != "gcc" ] || [ "$3" != "scripts/bad.sh" ]; then
  printf 'unexpected shellcheck argv: %s\n' "$*" >&2
  exit 64
fi
if [ -f .shellcheck-provider-ran ]; then
  printf 'shellcheck fixture passed\n'
  exit 0
fi
touch .shellcheck-provider-ran
printf 'scripts/bad.sh:1:1: error: deterministic shellcheck finding [SC1000]\n' >&2
exit 1

config_toml:
model_provider = "harness"

[model_providers.harness]
name = "Harness"
base_url = "{responses_base_url}"
wire_api = "responses"
requires_openai_auth = false
supports_websockets = false

[validation.groups]
functional = true
stylistic = false

[validation.providers.shellcheck]
enabled = true
command = ["/bin/sh", "fake-shellcheck"]
timeout_ms = 5000

item.name: apply_patch
item.input:
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: scripts/bad.sh
+#!/bin/sh
+printf '%s\n' "$value"
*** End Patch
